kata.name: FizzBuzz (negative control)
kata.series_verdict: killed (conventional 3/3 behavioral on a 7-line conditional; categorical rule table + partition checks: zero unique detections at several-times the overhead)

expected.detail: negative control: the series verdict is killed (conventional 3/3, categorical zero unique detections); catherine must self-negate — no path-equation expression of FizzBuzz rules may buy detection

commands: cargo run -p catherine-cli -- check fixtures/katas/fizzbuzz.ct.json --json  # exit 0, findings []
cargo run -p catherine-cli -- check fixtures/katas/fizzbuzz-f1-precedence.ct.json --json  # exit 0, findings [] (F1 precedence silently accepted)
cargo run -p catherine-cli -- check fixtures/katas/fizzbuzz-f2-divisibility.ct.json --json  # exit 0, findings [] (F2 mod-30 divisibility silently accepted)
cargo run -p catherine-cli -- check fixtures/katas/fizzbuzz-f3-zero-policy.ct.json --json  # exit 0, findings [] (F3 zero-policy domain leak silently accepted)
cargo run -p catherine-cli -- check fixtures/katas/fizzbuzz-probe-undeclared-output.ct.json --json  # exit 1 (construction probe: load rejected, see probes)

probes.name: undeclared-output-row

equations.rationale: negative control (kata-6): the only equation the path surface can state over the FizzBuzz rule table is this tautology - divisibility, coverage, and rule precedence have no equation form

probes.observed: exit 1; code syntax; message: table `output` maps `buzz` to `Bzz`, which is not a row of `Output` (line 21, column 42)

comparison.conventional_baseline: conventional 3/3 behavioral on a 7-line conditional (series fault matrix: F1 precedence, F2 mod-30 divisibility, F3 zero policy; every detection matched its frozen prediction)

expressibility_gap.invariant: divisibility predicates, coverage of 1..100, and rule precedence over the shared-multiple hazard (series F1 overlap_check, F2 coverage_check)
expressibility_gap.why: path equations compose total functions between declared rows; the surface has no arithmetic (mod), no order, and no coverage or precedence form - the only true equation over the rule table is the declared tautology, so no check can fire on any FizzBuzz fault

expressibility_gap.invariant: domain bounds: integers 1..100 with 0 and negatives rejected (series F3 domain_check)
expressibility_gap.why: domain membership is row vocabulary: an out-of-domain divisor is an expressible declared row, so the zero-policy leak is accepted with zero findings (executed: fizzbuzz-f3-zero-policy.ct.json)

procedure: 1. load the valid fixture and the three series-fault documents through the committed harness (catherine_ledger::harness::run - the same execution path the CLI and wasm boundary drive); the findings inventory is the executed detection set
2. positive control: the valid fixture must check clean (no false positives) - executed: exit 0, zero findings, the declared tautology evaluated on every rule row

3. fault matrix: F1 precedence (15 -> Buzz), F2 mod-30 divisibility, F3 zero-policy domain leak - executed: every fault document accepted with zero findings; catherine detects none of the three faults the 7-line conditional catches 3/3

4. unique-detection test: a detection is unique iff it catches a fault the conventional baseline misses; the baseline catches 3/3, so no catherine detection could be unique - executed: zero findings across all documents, therefore zero unique detections (a fired finding would have halted this procedure before any other kata ran)
5. construction probe (undeclared-output-row): rejected at load, exit 1, code syntax - row-vocabulary rejection, not a FizzBuzz detection; the conditional trivially exceeds it
6. verdict: killed - zero unique detections; the negative control self-negates, and the hypothesis (categorical modeling improves FizzBuzz-class design) is refuted for catherine as for the series
